_comment: Copy to config.json next to updater.py and edit. The GitHub token is NOT here on purpose - it lives in Windows Credential Manager under the name in credential_target, so it cannot end up in a backup, a screenshot, or a repo.
_playwright: One machine-wide browser cache. Without this, the updater running as a scheduled task under a different account gets its own 655 MB copy, and the first COA render after a deploy pays for the download.
